name: B & M Construction & Hvac LLC
description: A Whitehall-based contractor providing HVAC installation and repair alongside general construction work.

hero.headline: B & M Construction & Hvac LLC
hero.sub: HVAC installation and repair backed by a construction crew that can handle the job around it.

items: Heating and air conditioning installation and repair
Combined HVAC and build-out jobs from one crew
Serving Whitehall and the surrounding area
One crew for both HVAC and general construction work
Licensed and insured for residential and light commercial jobs

story.heading: About
paragraphs: B & M Construction & Hvac LLC grew out of doing both trades on the same jobs -- a new build or remodel almost always needs heating and cooling work too.
Running both under one crew means fewer subcontractors to coordinate and fewer gaps between trades.

items: A visit starts with a walkthrough and a written scope before any work is quoted.
HVAC and construction work is scheduled together when a job needs both.
Follow-up service is available after installation, not just during the build.

feature.heading: One crew for HVAC and construction
feature.text: Coordinating heating, cooling, and build-out work under one crew cuts the back-and-forth between trades.

spotlight.heading: From remodel to running system
spotlight.text: New construction and remodel jobs get HVAC planned in from the start, not bolted on at the end.
